---
title: "Announcing the iMOD User Day 2026"
description: "Announcement of the iMOD User Day at the Delft Software Days 2026"
author: "Joeri van Engelen"
date: "2026-08-11"
image: ../figures/about/training-delft-2025.jpg
---

The iMOD team is excited to announce that on Thursday 19 November 2026 we will
organize a day at the Delft Software Days (DSD) dedicated to iMOD and MODFLOW6.
The day will be filled with presentations, demo's, discussions, and training
about the latest developments in iMOD and MODFLOW6, as well as their
applications in groundwater modeling. 

There will be parallel sessions in the afternoon so you can choose whether you
want to attend tutorial, demo, or discussion sessions. Don't forget to subscribe
separately to these parallel events. The day will be concluded with a hydrology
dinner (for which you also need to register separately).

[You can find more information about the event and register for free at the DSD
website](https://softwaredays.deltares.nl/-/hydrology-software-days-day-4-imod-suite-and-modflow-6-2026)

This day is part of the Hydrology Software week, which is a week-long event
organized by Deltares dedicated to our hydrological software products. [So make
sure to check out the other days as well
here.](https://softwaredays.deltares.nl/program?session-topic=iwrm&startDate=16-11-2026)
We especially would like to highlight the Friday 20th of November, which will be
a full day of Advanced MODFLOW6 training, organized by the MODFLOW6 team. [You
can register for that
here.](https://softwaredays.deltares.nl/-/hydrology-software-days-day-5-modflow-6-advanced-training-2026)
